notes: The registry is extracted per tag from the client's own feature table (`pub const FEATURES` in codex-rs/features/src/lib.rs): key, lifecycle stage, default value, the rustdoc comment on the Feature enum variant, and — for experimental-stage flags — OpenAI's own /experimental menu name, description, and announcement copy.
Stage strings match `codex features list` output exactly: stable, experimental, under development, deprecated, removed.
rust-v0.153.1: lib.rs byte-identical to rust-v0.153.4; only the 0.153.4 snapshot is kept (see snapshot_aliases).
legacy.rs is byte-identical across all verified tags and is kept once at sources/legacy.rs; it maps legacy config keys (e.g. `telepathy`, `connectors`) to canonical flags.
history.first_seen is bounded by the earliest verified tag (rust-v0.148.0): a flag listed as first seen there may well predate it.
default_enabled is null when the source default is platform-conditional; the raw Rust expression is then in default_expr (currently only `cfg!(windows)`, for secret_auth_storage).
